source: (async function(tab,id,option){const h=eval(load("helpers"));await h.ev(tab,"(()=>{const e=document.getElementById("+JSON.stringify(id)+").closest('.select__control').querySelector('button');e.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});for(const type of ['pointerdown','mousedown','pointerup','mouseup','click'])e.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(type,{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,view:window,button:0,buttons:type.endsWith('down')?1:0}));return true})()");const opts=await h.ev(tab,"[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=option]')].filter(x=>x.id.startsWith('react-select')).map(x=>({id:x.id,text:x.innerText}))");if(option===null)return opts;const o=opts.find(x=>x.text===option);if(!o)throw Error(JSON.stringify(opts));await h.ev(tab,"document.getElementById("+JSON.stringify(o.id)+").click();true");return h.ev(tab,"document.getElementById("+JSON.stringify(id)+").closest('.select__control').innerText");})
note: Open inspected react-select button via full DOM mouse sequence, read real rendered options, select exact inspected text. No submit.
